procedure: Exported the lab files of the named commit with git archive into uncommitted private staging outside the repository.

Ran the one test command python -m pytest -q from the lab folder on the shipped starter with each listed Python (packages pinned by starter/requirements.txt, installed with the setup command): it failed exactly the declared failingTests.

Replaced only the learner-edited files (starter/signups_api/main.py, starter/signups_api/settings.py, starter/signups_api/upstream.py, starter/test_api.py) with the privately staged completed work; every other file stayed byte-identical to the commit.
Ran the same test command against the staged completion with each listed Python.
starterRun: Python 3.12.11: exit 1, 8 failed in 0.35s; the failures were exactly the 8 declared failingTests.
cleanup: The runs wrote only __pycache__ and .pytest_cache folders inside the staged lab, which the documented cleanup removes.
otherSystems: Linux and Windows runs are not yet recorded; hosted CI is currently disabled, so this macOS record is the only execution evidence (lab-contract section 10).
testScope: The checks call the app in-process through TestClient and replace the workshop catalog with an httpx.MockTransport, so no run opens a network connection; they observe status codes, JSON bodies, settings validation, the request the client sends and the learner's own tests run against four broken versions. The runs were made on the reviewed bytes after both critics' loop-2 rechecks closed every finding.
